text:
Omar: FYI I just opened a PR that touches KMS usage + audit event wiring. Can someone from sec take a look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5482 :lock:

Jane: on it, will review in ~2h :eyes:

Maria: pinging @Kevin (you led the HSM work) — any quick gotchas we should watch for in review?

Kevin: I can eyeball it later today. main things to check: key policy grants (unwrap/derive), whether we accidentally allow plaintext key export, and if audit events include the key id and caller context.

Omar: thanks — core change is switching to use `GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext` for ephemeral data keys and emitting a new audit event `kms_key_used` to the infra audit pipeline. small snippet in the PR description:```yaml
resources:
  - kms_key:
      uses: GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
      emit_audit: true
```

devops-bot: CI started for PR #5482 — 3/7 checks passing, failing test: `audit-log-formatter-test`

Jane: that failing test looks like the formatting hook didn't include the new field. @Omar can you add a unit that covers `kms_key_id` in the audit payload?

Omar: yep, adding the test now and will push. also adding a small migration to populate `kms_key_id` for older records.

Maria: please also add a short sentence in docs/security/audit-spec.md describing the new `kms_key_used` event and the `kms_key_id` field so SOC knows what to expect.

Kevin: one more: verify rotation behavior — if a key id is rotated/disabled we should still log the event (and mark key_id as historical), not fail the request. watch for code paths that assume key lookup is always successful.

Jane: recap for merge: reviewers @Jane @Kevin, Omar to push tests + docs, wait for green CI. plan to merge during maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC if everything is green. sound good?

Kevin: sounds good to me.

devops-bot: CI re-run triggered by Omar — all checks passed.

Jane: Approved. :thumbsup:

Omar: merging now. I'll post the changelog line and ping infra to schedule the rollout.

Maria: add a short note in the deploy changelog for SOC and compliance: "KMS audit events: `kms_key_used`, include `kms_key_id` — see PR #5482"

Omar: done, changelog updated and infra notified. thanks all! :lock_with_ink_pen:
